propositions: Fixture setup consumes 47% of tests/interfaces wall-clock due to rebar_repo being function-scoped, spawning 58 git processes (306 ms) per test across 589 test functions.

Template-per-worker with copytree (13.7x speedup to 22.3 ms) requires four fix-ups: worktree pointer rewriting, per-test gate snapshot tmpdir, re-randomized environment identity files, and pending cache reset.

Bare git worktree repair silently leaves copies pointing to the template's object store, allowing writes to advance the template's refs and making store isolation unfalsifiable; the guard must use git worktree list --porcelain, not git rev-parse --git-common-dir.

Session-scoped template fixture must build inside isolated MonkeyPatch context (REBAR_ROOT, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, deleted env vars, config cache reset) to prevent autouse contamination from the first test requester.
Half-fixed copies and bare-repaired copies must be rejected by a tier-wide autouse guard that validates all git worktree paths resolve inside REBAR_ROOT.
Deliberate init_repo coverage is preserved: test_init_idempotent_scratch.py and test_e4_init.py build from scratch at runtime; test_init_no_hardcoded_tracker.py remains static AST inspection.
